## Objective
Close the scoring side: benchmark-eval delta (bench-2 modules + evaluation delta + research/temporal deltas) so every published score is a function of bound evidence.

## Owning authority
- `docs/contracts/V87_READINESS_BENCHMARK_SPEC.md` §7 (explicit score formula), §10 (score-minting forbiddens)
- `v8-core/src/benchmark/{observation,population,projection,synthetic,report}.rs`, `v8-core/src/evaluation/{falsification,friction,production_growth,allegory,authority_surface,scope}.rs`, `v8-core/src/research/*`, `v8-core/src/temporal/mod.rs`, `v8-core/src/statistics/{detrended,remaining}.rs` (reference)
- Existing: `evaluation/{scoring,gate_resolution,store,statistics_plan,deflated_sharpe,multitest,overfitting,reality_check}.py`, `domain/market.frame_at`, `test_causality.py`
- Linked (not this issue): #322/#348 (stat kernels), #392/#327 (gates)

## Change class
CONTRACT_IMPLEMENTATION

## Current state
- Four-factor readiness computed; gate factor prefers resolved battery; regression baseline pinned.
- Delta: observation/population/projection semantics, synthetic-input labelling enforcement, evaluation-delta surfaces (falsification/friction/production_growth), research-delta verification (data_role/holdout vs `store.py`), temporal type-separation (`BarId`/`FundingEventId` vs `frame_at`), detrended/METH remainder.

## Required end state
- R1 — Published capability score is a function of the evidence the receipt binds (no score path bypasses the receipt).
- R2 — Synthetic inputs carry `SYNTHETIC_*` labels end-to-end and are rejected from evaluative aggregates (leakage audit green).
- R3 — Research-delta verified against `ResearchStore` (burn/lineage honored; frozen OOS never reopened).
- R4 — Temporal separation: disjoint id types for bars/funding/decisions; future-suffix mutation tests pass.
- R5 — Gates green including `audit_synthetic_leakage.py` and doc-path-refs guard.

## Expected file / module surface
- `v8-next/src/v8_next/evaluation/` — NEW delta modules; `scoring.py`, `report.py` (extend)
- `v8-next/src/v8_next/domain/` — temporal id-type separation (extend)
- `tools/audit_synthetic_leakage.py` (extend rules if new synthetic paths appear; guard-gated file — owner approval path applies)
- `v8-next/tests/test_scoring_*.py`, `test_temporal_*.py`

## Verification gates
```sh
uv run --project v8-next --extra dev ruff check v8-next/src v8-next/tests
uv run --project v8-next --extra dev mypy v8-next/src/v8_next/evaluation
python3 tools/audit_synthetic_leakage.py
uv run --project v8-next --extra dev pytest -q v8-next/tests/test_d153_parity.py v8-next/tests/test_gate_window_binding_406_421.py
```

## Required evidence artifacts
- Score-vs-receipt binding demonstration (receipt digest → score recomputation equality).
- Leakage-audit pass log. PENDING until produced.

## Non-goals / forbidden scope
- No gate-semantics changes (#392/#327 own them).
- No stat-kernel changes (#322/#348 own DSR/PBO/SPA).
- No protected-OOS opening (#377 owns OOS evidence).
- No economic claim.

## 11. Normative Traceability
- R1 — Score-from-evidence. Authority: readiness spec §§7, 10.
- R2 — Synthetic discipline. Authority: readiness spec §5; `v8-next/AGENTS.md` (MECHANICS ONLY rule).
- R3 — Research integrity. Authority: `v8-core/src/research/*` (Rules 11/17/18/34/35); `evaluation/store.py`.
- R4 — Temporal sovereignty. Authority: `v8-core/src/temporal/mod.rs` (Rules 44–50); D-139.
- R5 — Guards. Authority: repo audit tools (`audit_synthetic_leakage.py`, `audit_doc_path_refs.py`).

## 12. Existing Types / Interfaces to Reuse
- Receipt/digest/score types (existing evaluation modules; no parallel scoring ontology).
- `ResearchStore` burn/lineage metadata (existing).
- `frame_at` causal-frame conventions (extend types, don't fork).
- Existing gate-vector and certificate generators (read, don't rewrite).

## 13. Mathematical / Semantic Invariants
- I1 — score(receipt) is deterministic: same receipt bytes ⇒ same score. Testable: recompute-equality test.
- I2 — Synthetic share of any evaluative aggregate is exactly 0. Testable: leakage audit + aggregate provenance test.
- I3 — Id-type disjointness: a FundingEventId never resolves as a BarId. Testable: type-level + runtime tests.

## 14. Canonical Failure Semantics
- Score requested without bound receipt -> refusal (no score), never a default.
- Synthetic data reaching evaluative path -> hard failure with path named.
- Burned/protected data requested -> store rejection (existing behavior, keep).

## 15. Dependency Map
Chain issue #5 (pipeline) -> scoring/eval delta here -> readiness/target factors read the bound scores -> chain issue #7 (experts) measured against closed scoring.

## 16. Ambiguity / OPEN_PIN Triggers
- If upstream statistics/evaluation semantics contradict the readiness formula, STOP and escalate.
- If `remaining.rs` METH methods have no testable definition, STOP and declare OPEN_PIN rather than inventing methods.
- Default catch-all applies.

## References
- arXiv:2209.05559, arXiv:2603.09219 (spec-cited overfitting/protocol references).

## V8 guards
- [x] I will not invent a new canonical error code, ontology, or parallel interface unless an R# requirement explicitly authorizes it.
- [x] No unrelated semantic strategy change is bundled into this implementation issue.
- [x] No frozen OOS is opened unless this issue explicitly carries that authority.
- [x] If the owning contract is ambiguous, I will open/escalate an OPEN_PIN rather than invent an interpretation.

## Owner
ddawnlll

## Evidence

**Implementation revision:** `b78a86e3aea3aa1150e083ed01cdf3cea2056c9f` (5 files, owning surface only; base SHA `08255511973682703c74c674da007df225236979`).

### R1 — Score is a function of bound evidence (I1 deterministic)
- `ScoreEvidence` canon + `recompute_capability_score` (pre-existing, verified): unmeasured basis → `None` (never zero); undeclared/synthetic-tagged domains → `None` (never scored).
- Demo: `docs/evidence/v87-port-chain/455/score_recompute.json` sha256 `db33098420cb616e24d44d4f1e1834cc0846df1c54521357b2c807e51b4a275d` (evidence digest `708e1dbf…`, recompute twice `66.6 == 66.6`, coverage-tamper `41.6` detected).
- Exact check: `test_recompute_is_deterministic_per_evidence_bytes` + `test_tampered_evidence_does_not_reproduce_the_score` + `test_score_without_measured_basis_is_missing_never_zero` → PASS (MECHANICS ONLY hand fixtures).

### R2 — Synthetic discipline end-to-end (I2: synthetic share of evaluative aggregates is 0)
- `audit_synthetic_leakage.py` → ZERO leaks (with the #455 surface present).
- Enforcement seam proven: synthetic-tagged domain evidence → recompute `None` (test above); `synthetic.py` gate weights (pass 0.0 / fail 1.0); projection BFS-004 rejects synthetic-only forward claims.
- Exact check: leakage log in `docs/evidence/v87-port-chain/455/gates.log`.

### R3 — Research delta verified against ResearchStore
- Store behavior pinned (existing, kept): invalid coverage refused; burn lifecycle monotone (`holdout_pristine` true → burn → false; no unburn path — frozen OOS never reopened).
- Population roles: `ProtectedFrozenOos` + non-FrozenOOS role refused (test in #454 suite, still green).
- Exact check: `test_research_store_overlap_rejected_and_burn_is_monotone` → PASS.

### R4 — Temporal separation (I3 disjoint ids; future-suffix invariance)
- NEW `v8-next/src/v8_next/domain/temporal_ids.py`: `BarId`/`FundingEventId`/`DecisionTime` disjoint frozen classes (same payload never equal across types); `frame_at` untouched (no fork).
- Exact check: `test_id_types_are_disjoint` + `test_future_suffix_mutation_leaves_decision_frame_identical` → PASS (MECHANICS ONLY hand candles).
- OPEN_PINs cleared: no statistics/readiness contradiction observed; METH-3..6 all testably defined (kernels owned by #322/#348, untouched here).

### R5 — Gates (owning green; two guards foreign-red, named, close withheld)
- `ruff check src+tests` → All checks passed!; `mypy temporal_ids.py` → clean; new-file mypy for the surface clean.
- `pytest scoring_closure + temporal_ids` → 6 passed; `d153_parity + gate_window_binding` → 9 passed; fast loop `936 passed`; `regression` VERDICT OK (D-166); leakage audit OK.
- RED 1 (foreign, pre-existing): `audit_doc_path_refs.py` single FAIL — `v8-core/tests/integration/` cited at `ISSUE_PERF008…md:60` (committed `418bff0f` #333); no #455 file cites it (grep: no match). Fix belongs to the owning workstream; out of this issue's surface.
- RED 2 (foreign, pre-existing): full `mypy evaluation` 6 errors in `benchmark_receipt.py:1618-1620`, `scenarios.py:247/249`, `trajectory.py:43` — all tracked, unmodified by this issue; the #455 modules are clean file-by-file.
- Full log: `docs/evidence/v87-port-chain/455/gates.log` sha256 `6c9d26fcae977dcac2943f41b47555dbb63a500d985476c24a1c918daa9d2242`.

### Boundary respected
- Writes: NEW `domain/temporal_ids.py`, NEW `test_scoring_closure.py` + `test_temporal_ids.py`, `docs/evidence/v87-port-chain/455/` (2). `v8-core/`, `src/v8/`, root `tests/`, store/scoring semantics, stat kernels, gates, tools, OOS untouched. No economic claim.

### Commits
- `b78a86e3aea3aa1150e083ed01cdf3cea2056c9f` — `#455: scoring closure (temporal ids + score binding + guards, doc-path/mypy reds foreign-blocked)`
